verdict.rationale: Replicate is an API platform for running and fine-tuning models, so in-product AI insights on a user's data is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows built-in metrics and logs, which are non-AI monitoring, plus fine-tuning on your own data, which is a developer building block rather than in-product insights or suggestions. Nothing documents AI-generated insights surfaced inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
